crs_note: GeoJSON geometry is WGS84 lon/lat (CRS84). Properties EASTING/NORTHING are Irish Grid (EPSG:29903).
coverage_note: Signalised crossings and junctions with controlled crossing facilities, plus some uncontrolled points (CROSSING_TYPE_NAME: SIGNAL CONTROLLED 1372, UNCONTROLLED 196, ? 4). Pelican, puffin and toucan are not separated.
fetch_note: The CKAN API on www.opendatani.gov.uk returns 404 (the site front end). The API on admin.opendatani.gov.uk works. Downloads from the admin host returned 403 to the default curl client; they succeeded with a browser-style User-Agent header.
not_in_git: The raw GeoJSON stays under H:/BelfastData/dfi_crossings/raw.
